title: Agent Browser Task
description: Definition for a reusable Agent Browser task with structured inputs and outputs.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the task does.

inputSchema.description: JSON schema defining the expected input parameters for this task.

outputSchema.description: JSON schema defining the structure of the deterministic output.

webhookUrl.description: Optional webhook URL to call upon task completion or failure.

steps.description: A sequence of instructions or prompts to execute the task.

action.description: The command or prompt to execute (e.g., 'goto', 'click', 'read', or a natural language prompt).
